findings.detail: New refusal and stale-response cases reuse the existing trackReviewAction/finishReviewAction helper, which accesses Vue's private _vei event invoker to await actual returned handler promises. This is framework-internal maintenance coupling, not a product authorization defect. The helper and old tests were not relaxed by this tranche.
findings.disposition: Retain as known test maintenance item; no release-blocking change required for this bounded batch.

rulings.evidence: originalEvidence validates the complete Evidence shape and only selects kind original with non-null exact ObjectRef and SHA equality; originalAsset validates the complete Asset shape, original/VALID, positive safe sizes and exact case/asset/ObjectRef. UUIDs compare canonically; version and SHA remain exact. This is expressly a strict subset, not a general Evidence invariant.

target requires loaded/nonbusy evidence data, valid actor/org/context, current visible case membership, exact task/run/result, permitted review references, recognized page envelope and the selected evidence as a member of the current page. It does not silently switch task/history/page or fall back to a different object.

UI requires review.read, evidence.read and asset.read for detail, while createAssetDownload separately requires asset.download. It calls only existing getAsset/downloadAsset operations. Server functionality is unchanged, so actual object/source download-purpose authorization and transaction-end fencing remain the existing independent gates. Local permission display is not a server authorization grant.

Download selection re-evaluates target, bound signature and originalAsset at every underlying download checkpoint. Existing unchanged createAssetDownload captures immutable values and validates Blob size, content SHA and the ObjectRef-derived ETag before saveBlob. No guessed object-store URL, history query, direct media playback or new endpoint is added.

A synchronous signature watcher covers session generation, same-generation user/org/roles/permissions/case membership and all evidence/context/page selection content. clear invalidates both readers and downloads. Metadata reload clears download state even with identical selection; component unmount disposes original first and the evidence reader second.

load checks independent operation generation and full signature before setting data or error. The unchanged download helper re-checks current selection after response bytes, after Blob.arrayBuffer and after asynchronous SHA work; clear increments its generation so stale successes and errors cannot save bytes or publish status into a new context. Browser save is only reached after all integrity checks.

New unit cases examine strict malformed selections/Evidence/Asset envelopes, permission separation, UUID compatibility, every context invalidation, late reads/binary errors, Blob-stage invalidation, integrity failures and duplicate-click guards. Existing browser file is 519 added lines/0 deleted lines versus base; old 138 cases/expectations are retained. The added parameterized groups expand to 34 cases using self-owned transport fixtures; successful download consumes the actual browser Download stream and compares bytes. No assertion weakening, skip or failure bypass was introduced. This reviewer did not execute tests.

ReviewEvidencePanel states that only exact original evidence/current VALID original asset references can be downloaded, with no derived media or playback and no legal-effect claim. TaskReviewHistoryPanel wording now reflects separate controlled download permission rather than the former metadata-only statement. No approval or real identity acceptance is implied.

Five frontend product/test files only. Existing asset-download.ts is an unchanged base dependency; there is no public contract, SQL, package-lock, CI gate, model or shared-runtime change in this reviewed tranche.

This is a fresh source review of the five exact LF hashes, not Xu Changsheng's personal acceptance and not runtime/test/CI evidence. Ownership/designated reviewer assignment does not establish independent dual review. Formal identity/source policy E2E, derived playback and complete T103 acceptance remain outside the tranche.

dependency_review.conclusion: Compatible strict UI subset within existing public contracts and reusable download capability; no material contract or SQL change required. Pending code implementation and actual tests.
strict_subset: Only a currently selected, already validated Evidence.kind == original is eligible, with a non-null valid controlled ObjectRef.

Fetch getAsset by that evidence asset_id through BusinessSession; validate the complete Asset schema before reuse. Existing createAssetReader only checks case_id/asset_id and is insufficient alone as a strict response validator.
Require Asset.kind == original and state == VALID; current case_id and asset_id must match selected evidence and current review context.
Require all ObjectRef components object_id/version_id/sha256 to match evidence exactly after UUID canonical comparison, and Evidence.sha256 == evidence.object_ref.sha256 for this subset only.
Do not generalize this equality to frame/region/segment/match/text/snapshot/model_output evidence. Their Evidence.sha may identify different semantics and no blanket rule is introduced.
Current metadata mismatch, unavailable bytes or historical asset no longer matching must fail closed; do not substitute a different asset/version/latest result or guess a storage URL.

Evidence metadata read remains protected by review.read plus evidence.read in the UI and actual server evidence guards; asset metadata/download additionally require their own asset.read/asset.download, case/object/current-source checks.

Snapshot and invalidate pending reads/downloads for evidence/sourceKey/history/page/user/roles/permissions/case membership/session generation changes and component disposal; late results must not populate a new context.

Reuse createAssetDownload for size, content SHA and fixed ObjectRef ETag verification before browser save. The server fully buffers within existing max_upload_bytes, verifies byte length/SHA, audits and commits before returning any content.

The backend existing ScopedObjects asset_content path repeats authorization fences and source download-purpose authorization while consuming storage bytes, followed by transaction-end authorization. No standalone evidence download authority is inferred.
restrictions: This is original asset read/download only, not inline media preview, playback, derived media rendering, range-to-timeline mapping or a complete T103 acceptance.
No new public contract field, endpoint, query parameter, permission, business rule, SQL migration, model inference, package lock or CI gate change is proposed.

Do not add history selectors to getAsset or downloadAsset; existing contracts reject such query parameters. Version binding for this subset is verified via exact returned ObjectRef and download ETag/content.
No guessed object-store/public URLs, external fetches, fake evidence or approvals. Browser object URLs may only be temporary artifacts used by existing saveBlob after verified bytes.
Synthetic transport or unit fixtures cannot establish real identity/authorization/object-store end-to-end success, formal policy effectiveness or real algorithm evidence production.
User-confirmed ownership and designated review assignment are not evidence that the person performed acceptance review or granted system permissions.
Python candidates, algorithms and model/effect evaluation remain deferred; shared services and shared data are not modified.
required_test_focus: Original-only and null/malformed/mismatched ObjectRef rejection, including equal content SHA but different object_id/version_id.
Mismatched case/asset, derived asset, invalid state, malformed/extra/missing Asset fields, unsafe integers or invalid dates are refused before content request.
Separate permission denials and identity/case/history/page/evidence changes during metadata read or download; stale success and stale failure cannot overwrite current state or save bytes.
Existing download verifies size/SHA/ETag; repeated clicks are guarded; errors clear prior successful state and no fallback requests occur.
Browser transport tests distinguish metadata-read and download permissions and bind exact API requests; no object URL/domain guessing.
